title: [dev-l] After UI update graph labels doubled
body: Milosz, thank you first of all for your tireless work. Maybe the UI update is not ready yet yesterday. If it is, I would like to ask you to label again on the graph again (as before) only every 2nd line: So BG values only with 40-80-120-etc. and not show every hour twice. This would be an optical advantage at least for small screens ...

comments.body: Addition: Compared to an old screenshot, it is noticeable that the number of grid lines has doubled, not the labeling. Maybe this is the way?

it can be related to graphview update. I didn't notice this change on my phone
Could you test reverting this commit https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/4350a2d5d178038c1debe0e38556fb35fe8dd6d8 ?

@MilosKozak they are (not) doubled, but it looks like than they are .
One hour has 2 entries: one for the full hour , one for the half hour . Maybe it’s configurable ?
